text:
maria: Heads up — vendor CI logs in S3 contain a base64 KMS ciphertext snippet. Treat as exposure. :rotating_light:

aj: share a redacted example + path (no full blob in channel)

maria: redacted sample: `KMS_CT: eyJj...REDACTED==` path: s3://vendor-ci-logs/2026-03-19/build-42/log.txt

dena: ciphertext < plaintext but assume compromise. Immediate rotate + tighten RBAC. Create incident.

vaultbot: Incident created: INC-20260319-0923. Priority: P2. Owners: maria, aj. Ack

aj: I'm creating new key version and removing vendor SA decrypt perms. Commands:
```
gcloud kms keys versions create --key=rw-key --location=global --keyring=redwood-keyring --project=redwood-prod
gcloud kms keys remove-iam-policy-binding projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/redwood-keyring/cryptoKeys/rw-key --member="serviceAccount:ci@vendor-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter"
```
I'll report back.

sam: For rewrap: propose worker that calls Vault transit rewrap via old->new. Dry-run first. Need owners to freeze writes to mounts.

dena: Also apply temporary IAM deny on old key for vendor project and enable KMS audit sink to dedicated logs bucket. Route to SIEM.

erin: payments team pauses CI deploys. available window 11:30-12:00 UTC.

maria: Created JIRA INFR-8432 with redacted mounts/owners. PR opened to mask TF outputs and add sensitive flags. Also add CI no_log.

aj: Done: removed vendor SA binding, created key version v5 and set PRIMARY, enabled KMS audit logging, bumped rotation policy to 30d, alert on decrypt spikes.

sam: Runbook sketch:
1) pause writes to affected Vault mounts
2) snapshot ciphertext list (owners verify)
3) rewrap via transit/rewrap or KMS re-encrypt paths
4) verify in staging apps
5) swap and resume
I'll post scripts to ticket.

dena: Rotate any long-lived secrets that vendor SA could've decrypted historically (DB creds, third-party tokens). Scoped priority to high-risk.

oncall: Monitoring set for unusual decrypts/403s. Paging if unknown principals appear.

maria: Post-mitigation checklist: confirm rewrap, revoke old key versions or remove decrypt permissions, run KMS/Vault access review, rotate long-lived creds, update infra docs to pin providers and hide outputs.

aj: Attaching KMS rotation logs to INFR-8432. Scheduling rewrap for 11:40 UTC during payments window.

maria: Targeting close of INC-20260319-0923 by 14:00 UTC after verification. Will notify legal for vendor disclosure.

dena: We'll do a brief postmortem and add CI lint to block printing KMS blob-like strings.

maria: ACK, thanks everyone.
